The owner-recorded search page stays private. Set `LAMPASTREAM_PROVIDER_FIXTURES`
to the directory containing `songbpm-search-mau-p.html` and `urls.txt`.
The recorded result URL is generated by a POST to `/searches` with form field
`query` (as shown by the form in the recording). Tests serve the page on loopback.
Expected match: Mau P — Just A Little Bit More, 128 BPM.
